types.name: Fenrir::Entity
types.doc: Entity class that is used to interact with the entity list. This forms the basis of the ECS

types.name: Fenrir::EntityId
types.doc: The entity id a scene file gives an entity: minted once, when the entity is first saved, and kept for its life (ADR-0078). It is how a file names an entity, for a parent or an entity field; it is not the run-time Entity, which a load reassigns. A file spells it as a string (SpellEntityId), as the block's `id`.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The id's spelling, packed: below a leading 1 bit, five bits per lower-case Crockford base32 character, the first character highest. Zero, which no spelling packs to, means no id.

types.name: Fenrir::Instance
types.doc: Marks a scene instance's root: the entities under it were made from another scene file or a model file, and the host's file writes them as that source plus overrides (ADR-0080). A file spells it as the block's `instance`.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: The source's asset path, relative to the asset root, zero-terminated (so at most 255 bytes).

types.name: Fenrir::Name
types.doc: An entity's name: a fixed 256-byte UTF-8 buffer, so at most 255 bytes of text. Every entity has one.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The bytes, zero-terminated (so the name is at most 255 bytes).

types.name: Fenrir::Relationship
types.doc: Where an entity sits in the hierarchy: its parent, its first child and its siblings, each the empty Entity when there is none. Every entity has one, and the entity list keeps the links consistent.

fields.name: firstChild
fields.doc: The first of its children; the rest follow through each child's nextSibling.

fields.name: nextSibling
fields.doc: The next child of its parent.

fields.name: prevSibling
fields.doc: The previous child of its parent.

types.name: Fenrir::Transform
types.doc: An entity's place in the world, relative to its parent: every entity has one.

fields.name: pos
fields.doc: The position, relative to the parent.

fields.name: rot
fields.doc: The rotation, relative to the parent.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: The scale on each axis, relative to the parent.
